svg.title: A running total looks serial; it needs only 3 steps
svg.desc: Two panels on the eight values 3 1 7 0 4 1 6 3. Left, the serial loop: each running total adds its input to the total before it, so the totals 3 4 11 11 15 16 22 25 form a chain of 7 dependent additions, drawn as red arrows numbered 1 to 7. Right, Hillis-Steele: at stride 1, 2 and 4 every element adds the element that many places back, all at once; the rows read 3 4 8 7 4 5 7 9, then 3 4 11 11 12 12 11 14, then the same totals, in 3 parallel steps.
svg.text: A running total looks serial; it needs only 3 steps
The post's eight values; every number is printed by scan_model.py.
addition i needs the result of addition i − 1,
so the 7 additions run one after another
an addition that waits for the one before
element t adds element t − stride
Same 8 totals: 7 additions in a chain, or 3 steps in which every element adds at once.
